_how: Each page is one domain. Queries run in Sentinel: measures return week_ending and value (12 completed weeks, {weeks} is filled in), breakdowns return name and value, ranked lists return the named columns plus an optional detail column. 'sample' is shown until the query returns data. Table and column names follow Microsoft's connector documentation; check them in your workspace. Copy this file to the data folder as domains.json to change it.

domains.title: Cloud risks
domains.intro: Misconfigurations and threats in Azure and other clouds, from Defender for Cloud and Orca as they arrive in Sentinel.
domains.needs: Defender for Cloud continuous export to the Sentinel workspace (SecurityRecommendation, SecureScores) and the Orca Security Alerts connector (OrcaAlerts_CL).

measures.label: High-severity cloud misconfigurations
measures.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationSeverity == 'High' | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = dcount(strcat(AssessedResourceId, '|', RecommendationName)) by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

measures.label: Cloud secure score
measures.query: SecureScores | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d)  | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = round(avg(PercentageScore) * 100, 0) by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

measures.label: Orca cloud alerts raised
measures.query: OrcaAlerts_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d)  | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = count() by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

measures.label: Cloud threat alerts
measures.query: SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d) | where ProductName in ('Azure Security Center', 'Microsoft Defender for Cloud')  | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = dcount(SystemAlertId) by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

breakdowns.title: Open misconfigurations by severity
breakdowns.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | summarize value = dcount(strcat(AssessedResourceId, '|', RecommendationName)) by name = RecommendationSeverity | order by value desc

breakdowns.title: Orca alerts by type
breakdowns.query: OrcaAlerts_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(28d) | summarize value = count() by name = alert_type_s | top 8 by value
sample: Vulnerable service on a running asset

ranked.title: Resources with the most high-severity issues
ranked.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationSeverity == 'High' | extend resource = tostring(split(AssessedResourceId, '/')[-1]), rtype = tostring(split(AssessedResourceId, '/')[-2]) | summarize Issues = dcount(RecommendationName) by Resource = resource, detail = rtype | top 10 by Issues

ranked.title: Most widespread misconfigurations
ranked.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | summarize Resources = dcount(AssessedResourceId) by Recommendation = RecommendationName, detail = RecommendationSeverity | top 10 by Resources
sample: Machines should have vulnerability findings resolved
Storage accounts should restrict network access
Management ports should be closed on virtual machines
MFA should be enabled for accounts with owner permissions

domains.title: DevSecOps risks
domains.intro: Security issues found in code, dependencies, infrastructure templates and container images before they reach production.
domains.needs: Defender for Cloud DevOps security connected to your GitLab or GitHub organisations, with continuous export to Sentinel. GitLab's own findings can be added through the GitLab connector or a CSV measure.

measures.label: Open code and pipeline findings
measures.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationName has_any ('secret', 'dependenc', 'code', 'IaC', 'infrastructure as code', 'container image', 'repository')  | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = dcount(strcat(AssessedResourceId, '|', RecommendationName)) by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

measures.label: Secrets found in code
measures.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationName has 'secret'  | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = dcount(AssessedResourceId) by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

measures.label: Vulnerable dependencies
measures.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationName has 'dependenc'  | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = dcount(AssessedResourceId) by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

measures.label: Container images with critical issues
measures.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationName has 'container image'  | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = dcount(AssessedResourceId) by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

breakdowns.title: Open findings by kind
breakdowns.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationName has_any ('secret', 'dependenc', 'code', 'IaC', 'infrastructure as code', 'container image', 'repository') | extend name = case(RecommendationName has 'secret', 'Secrets in code', RecommendationName has 'dependenc', 'Vulnerable dependencies', RecommendationName has_any ('IaC', 'infrastructure as code'), 'Infrastructure templates', RecommendationName has 'container image', 'Container images', 'Code weaknesses') | summarize value = dcount(strcat(AssessedResourceId, '|', RecommendationName)) by name | order by value desc

ranked.title: Repositories with the most open findings
ranked.query: SecurityRecommendation | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where RecommendationState == 'Unhealthy' | where RecommendationName has_any ('secret', 'dependenc', 'code', 'IaC', 'infrastructure as code', 'container image', 'repository') | extend repo = tostring(split(AssessedResourceId, '/')[-1]) | summarize Findings = dcount(RecommendationName) by Repository = repo, detail = '' | top 10 by Findings

domains.title: SAP
domains.intro: Threats, weaknesses and malware in SAP, from SecurityBridge, Bowbridge and the Microsoft Sentinel solution for SAP applications.
domains.needs: Connect SecurityBridge to Sentinel with its connector, deploy the Sentinel solution for SAP applications, and forward Bowbridge's virus-scan events to a custom table. Confirm the table names in your workspace, then set this page's status to live in domains.json.
will_show: SAP security alerts per week, by rule, from SecurityBridge and the Sentinel SAP rules
Missing SAP security notes and critical configuration findings per system (SecurityBridge)
ABAP custom code findings by severity (SecurityBridge code scanning)
Malware found in files uploaded to SAP (Bowbridge)
Activity by privileged and emergency (firefighter) users, and changes to critical parameters
Which SAP systems are sending data, and which are late

measures.label: SAP security alerts
measures.query: SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d) | where AlertName startswith 'SAP - '  | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = dcount(SystemAlertId) by week_ending | order by week_ending asc

breakdowns.title: SAP alerts by rule
breakdowns.query: SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(28d) and AlertName startswith 'SAP - ' | summarize value = dcount(SystemAlertId) by name = AlertName | top 10 by value

domains.title: Web edge
domains.intro: Attacks on public websites and services stopped at the edge: web attacks, bots and denial of service, from Cloudflare.
domains.needs: Send Cloudflare logs to Azure storage with Logpush and turn on the Cloudflare codeless connector in Sentinel (table CloudflareV2_CL). Confirm the field names after the first delivery, then set this page's status to live.
will_show: Web attacks blocked by the web application firewall, by rule and by site
Bot traffic and challenges, and denial-of-service events
Which public services are attacked most, and from where
Attacks that got past the edge and reached an application, matched to Sentinel incidents

measures.label: Web attacks blocked
measures.query: CloudflareV2_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago({weeks} * 7d) | extend week_ending = startofweek(TimeGenerated - 1d) + 7d | where week_ending < startofday(now()) | summarize value = count() by week_ending | order by week_ending asc
